input.sha256_scope: Concatenation of the twenty-one raw C-order input byte arrays in capture document order.
input.provenance: Self-authored in-memory interleaved uint8 values emitted by tools/capture_crop_oracle.py --suite channel-grid.

expected.sha256_scope: Concatenation of the twenty-one raw C-order output byte arrays in capture document order.

limitations: This is an exact regression fixture only for its twenty-one self-authored interleaved cases and the recorded scalar OpenCV 5.0.0 environment.
The one-, two-, and four-channel cases carry no colour meaning; this project has frozen no such semantics, and the label opaque-N records that deliberately.
It does not establish image-decoder, RGB/BGR conversion, alpha, orientation, detector, recognizer, model, or end-to-end OCR compatibility.
It does not establish universal OpenCV INTER_CUBIC bit equivalence or a portable SIMD/FMA policy.
